Nothing says the quiz is held in Old Mary's, and the claim quietly renames the venue to 'The Mitre', so criterion (b), a quiz at the pub on the CANDIDATE line, is not clearly met.; Everything else checks out: the quote matches line 59 of the https://www.themitrehydepark.com/whats-on block exactly. The claim fails the quote rule. Neither the quote 'September 29th 2026, 08:00 PM' nor the extra quote 'Join us for our fun filled quiz in Pinner weekly.' contains Tuesday/Tue/Tues, and the whats-on page never uses that word, so no quote from that page can satisfy the machine check.; The only 'EVERY TUESDAY' is on a different page (https://www.caseisalteredpinner.co.uk/parties-events, line 88: 'Quiz Night' / 'EVERY TUESDAY'). That page gives no start time, so it cannot be combined with the whats-on quote under the same-page rule.; On substance the evidence is supportive: the whats-on page (Young's pub site) lists Quiz Night at 08:00 PM on Sep 1, 8, 15, 22 and 29, 2026, all Tuesdays, and says it is 'weekly'.
